device.comment: The screen this game is drawn for and judged at. art/world/bible.md and art/interface/bible.md rule against a portrait phone with a 1080 px short edge, which is 540x960 at pixel ratio 2. The engine viewport and every see.capture read this.

plugins.comment: Mouse Look captures the pointer the moment play starts and rebinds the keys for a shooter. Nothing here is aimed with a mouse.
